# Requirements Traceability Matrix

**Path:** `docs/traceability/requirements-traceability.md` (D-09)
**Source-of-truth:** `.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md` (REQ-IDs) + `.planning/phases/02.1-test-infrastructure-video-quality-remediation-1-regenerate-t/02.1-TEST-PLAN.md` (tcids)
**Generated:** 2026-07-07 by `gsd-executor` (plan 04-04, task 2 — extended with F6 rows for DL-01..04 + INFRA-04)

## Schema

- **REQ-ID** — matches `.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md` exactly
- **Description** — one-line summary from `REQUIREMENTS.md`
- **Phase** — the phase that ships the requirement (per `REQUIREMENTS.md ## Traceability`)
- **Test Case IDs** — the tcids that prove the requirement; comma-separated, listed in the order from `docs/traceability/TEST-PLAN.md`. Suffix: `-SC` = BDD scenario OR Playwright spec; `-UT` = unit-test group; `F-UT` = frontend unit-test group.
- **BDD Scenario file:line** — the canonical citation for "where is this requirement's contract defined in the BDD Gherkin"
- **Status** — `Complete` (Phase 1/2 shipped) or `Pending` (Phase 3/4 not yet shipped)

## Contract

This matrix is the single source of truth for "which test proves which requirement". Any future test MUST add its tcid to the corresponding REQ-ID row. The matrix is consumed by:

- `backend/AGENTS.md` (Phase 2 BDD contract section) and `frontend/AGENTS.md` — both reference this matrix so future tests know to add their tcids.
- Plan 02.1-02 (tcid retrofit) — adds `@pytest.mark.tcid("…")` markers (Python) + `test.info().annotations` (Playwright) for the Test Case IDs in this matrix.
- Plan 02.1-04 (re-record video) — asserts the F2 @smoke scenario (`CONF-01-SC01`) is `Full` before re-recording.

If a requirement gains a new test, append its tcid to the row below AND add a row to `docs/traceability/TEST-PLAN.md`. If a requirement is removed, delete the row + delete the corresponding row in `docs/traceability/TEST-PLAN.md`.

### Mapping statistics

- **25 of 25 Complete REQ-IDs** have at least one BDD scenario OR Playwright spec covering them (EPUB-03 is the canonical-chapter-rule exception — it has only a unit-test binding because the rule is implicit in every F1 fixture; the F6 download surface adds 10 BDD scenarios + 2 Playwright specs that cover DL-01..04 + INFRA-04). JOBS-06 is the new quick-task REQ-ID (Quick 260710-oih); it has only a unit-test binding (5 new tests in `test_jobs_router.py`) because the change is a pure UX surface (Cancel button + endpoint) with no new BDD scenarios.
- **2 JOBS-03 tcids span two feature files** (`JOBS-03-SC10` and `JOBS-03-SC11` are the F3 "Per-chapter progress reporting" scenarios; `JOBS-03-SC09` + `JOBS-03-SC10` are the F5 WS scenarios). The matrix lists both with `-F3` suffix to disambiguate.
- **2 F4 defer_combined scenarios** (VOICE-04-SC05, VOICE-04-SC06) are listed as `Skipped` in `docs/traceability/TEST-PLAN.md`; the matrix includes them under VOICE-04. Phase 4 / plan 04-04 REMOVED the `@defer_combined` marker from these 2 scenarios (the step bodies were re-bound in plan 04-02; the marker was the last seam).
- **6 F6 out-of-scope scenarios** (3 retention TTL + 2 large-artifact streaming + 1 audio-spoken filename) are `@pytest.mark.skip`'d with docstring references to CONTEXT.md rationale. The skips are not counted in the test-id inventory but are documented in the matrix via the F6 file:line ranges.
